bio.text: Jibreel Jalloh is a community organizer from Canarsie, Brooklyn, who filed in November 2025 to run for Assembly District 59, according to City & State.
City & State reported that he is the founder and executive director of the nonprofit The Flossy Organization and an Obama Foundation Scholar at Columbia University.
Ballotpedia lists him on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot for District 59 on the Working Families Party line; it reports he lost the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.

sources.title: In southeast Brooklyn, community organizer Jibreel Jalloh files to run against Jaime Williams
